observations.trace: SceneTerrain’s 3×2 example forms X-major flat heights [0,10,1,13,4,20] then chunks by width3, yielding2 outer rows of3. Pinned Avian flattens the nested vectors unchanged into Parry Array2(rows=2,columns=3); pinned Parry indexes column-major i+j*rows, assigns row i to Z and column j to X, and uses the same default diagonal as SceneTerrain query and mesh. Thus this particular axis-transposition suspicion is not supported by the inspected implementations.

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional distinct destinations collapse into a zero-length route and unavailable map
conditional_findings.first_contract: A selected geographic destination distinct from the origin must have an explicit short-distance route and presentation contract when both endpoints snap to the same routing node.
conditional_findings.trace: The selected-destination route path requests TerrainPlanner with the current and target coordinates. On a cache miss, TerrainPack builds a 30m-or-coarser window and rounds then snaps both coordinates. If both snap to the same valid node, A* immediately reconstructs one node; its empty edge list yields distance0 and minutes0, and both route simplifiers preserve the one point. apply_terrain_route accepts that successful plan, replaces the destination distance/minutes and retains Some(plan). MapPresentation only tries to draw a route when the selected marker origin differs from the current origin, and MapRoute::new rejects a one-point computed route. strategic_map catches that error and produces its map-unavailable markup. This is source tracing only; no route, terrain pack, marker, HTTP request or UI was run.
conditional_findings.symbolic_witness: Assume an otherwise valid hypothetical pack covering longitude and latitude [−1°,1°], a cache miss, valid profile and successful sampling, start (latitude0°, longitude0°) and selected endpoint (latitude0°, longitude0.000001°). The microdegree positions differ. The first window uses 0.01° padding and, in ideal real arithmetic at latitude0°, 30/111320 degree spacing. Both longitudes and latitude round to grid index37; the window is 76×76 nodes, below the750000 cap, so no coarsening is required. If the shared node is passable and upstream knowledge/selection admissions hold, both snaps coincide and the one-point chain above follows. Rational bounds—not a native floating-point run—place both horizontal values between37 and37.5.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: This is an artificial geographic example, not a claim that the actual imported pack or player has those locations. Snapping, cache hits, source terrain, case-site knowledge, settlement membership, timeout and upstream destination selection can prevent or alter the scenario; no native planner or browser output was observed. The retained zero distance/time reaches the selected presentation data in source, but actual journey submission, server authorization and elapsed-time effects remain unverified. The constructor accepts two equal points as a separate policy question; do not conflate that case with this producer’s one-point rejection or the adjacent-duplicate normalization of RegionalConnection.
connected_repair_dependencies: Define same-node routing semantics for distinct precise origins/destinations and decide whether exact endpoint connectors, an explicit estimate, or another checked zero-edge representation owns distance and duration. Trace both normal and return routes, snap-to-passable, caching and strategic journey authority.

Keep MapOverlay knowledge admission, typed geographic source identity, route kind and valid ordinary/closed routes; connect route cardinality handling and error presentation without fabricating covered terrain.

Later authorized verification should exercise distinct endpoints snapping together, equal true endpoints, nearby blocked/snap cases, ordinary computed and estimated routes, selected display and authoritative journey timing; do not run during this audit.
